battle.name: 馬庫斯·李錫尼·克拉蘇
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞卡雷平原
battle.brief: 公元前53年，執政官克拉蘇率七個軍團自敘利亞北上，因亞美尼亞王誤導，取道險遠山徑；抵美索不達米亞卡雷平原，安息總帥蘇雷納以弓騎環繞、鎧甲重騎破陣，克拉蘇父子陣亡，全軍盡沒。卡面科林斯青銅盔為全覆面甲極致，已讓位於開面羅馬盔，借它標示羅馬縱隊失卻視線聽覺，只能靠封閉方陣與號角維繫。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 公元前53年5月的卡雷之戰，交戰的兩大陣營是羅馬共和國與安息王國。羅馬方面是由執政官馬庫斯·李錫尼·克拉蘇統率的遠征軍：主力為七個軍團，步卒合計約兩萬上下，另有羅馬騎兵約三千人，以及高盧人、色雷斯人與日耳曼人組成的雇傭騎兵約三千人，輔以輕裝步兵與射手，全軍連同輜重、帳篷與糧秣由敘利亞的安提阿出發，沿安東尼斯山脈東行。安息方面，國王奧羅德斯二世坐鎮泰西封，實際統兵者是身居安息騎兵總帥之位的蘇雷納，他徵集諸游牧部落的弓騎與重裝騎兵，屯兵於卡雷以西的底格里斯與幼發拉底斯之間，專候羅馬縱隊鑽入平原。同時安息取得亞美尼亞王阿爾塔瓦斯得二世的默契，羅馬東翼受制；同年安息騎兵在北面的阿拉克斯河擊敗德基穆斯·布魯圖斯率領的羅馬軍，兩路配合，使遠征的羅馬軍在戰略上腹背受敵。全程沒有第三國正式介入，也沒有宣戰程序；羅馬方面的出兵帶著恢復國威的宣傳色彩，實質是帝國邊疆政策與執政官個人政治資本綁在一起的冒險。
countriesEn: The Battle of Carrhae, fought in May of 53 BC, pitted two camps against each other: the Roman Republic and the Parthian kingdom. On the Roman side stood the expeditionary army commanded by the consul Marcus Licinius Crassus: its core was seven legions, roughly twenty thousand foot in all, together with about three thousand Roman cavalry and about three thousand mercenary horse recruited from Gauls, Thracians and Germans, supplemented by light infantry and skirmishers. With its baggage train, tents and grain supply the column left Antioch in Syria and moved east along the ranges of the Anti-Taurus. On the Parthian side the king Orodes II sat at Ctesiphon, but the man who actually commanded was Surena, holder of the Parthian command of the horse; he gathered mounted archers and heavily armoured riders from the nomadic tribes of the realm and posted them between the Tigris and the Euphrates west of Carrhae, waiting for the Roman column to walk out onto the plain. At the same time Parthia had the tacit support of Artavasdes II of Armenia, pinning the Roman flank, and in the same year Parthian horse defeated the Roman force of Decimus Brutus at the Araxes in the north, so that the two blows fell together and the Roman expedition was squeezed from front and rear. No third state intervened formally and there was no declaration of war; the Roman expedition was presented at home as a restoration of national honour, but in substance it was a gamble that tied imperial frontier policy to one consul's political capital.
people: 決定這場戰役命運的是四類人物。第一是馬庫斯·李錫尼·克拉蘇本人：商人家族的富豪，前55年當選執政官、前54年就職，前53年任期屆滿需要戰功，他在羅馬推行嚴苛的奴隸法、修築街道與穀倉，被同僚譏為只知聚財而無兵才，卻也是最堅決主張再派大軍東征安息的人；出發前他在城界之外反覆以羔羊獻祭，內臟屢示不吉，祭牲多次掙脫逃逸，他仍執意出征。第二是他的長子普布利烏斯·克拉蘇，時任行政官兼將軍，前54年曾在亞美尼亞擊敗安息總督奧雷斯特斯而受好評，卡雷之戰中受命率領羅馬騎兵，追擊安息弓騎時陷於包圍，與數百騎一同戰死。第三是安息騎兵總帥蘇雷納，他不僅在戰場上策劃佯敗與包圍，還在得勝後因驕縱與勢力過大被奧羅德斯二世以叛國罪名處死，連家屬亦遭誅戮，說明安息王權與貴族權力的緊張。第四是周邊人物：亞美尼亞王阿爾塔瓦斯得二世屢次為安息引路，誤導羅馬行軍路線；德基穆斯·布魯圖斯在北方被帕科魯斯擊敗；西塞罗在《占卜者的答覆》痛陳克拉蘇頭顱送回羅馬之事，批評祖國在敗仗中歡呼。普魯塔克《克拉蘇傳》與阿里安《亞歷山大紀要》則是後世記述此役的主要來源。
peopleEn: Four kinds of figure decided the outcome of this campaign. The first is Marcus Licinius Crassus himself: the son of a wealthy merchant house, elected consul in 55 BC and in office from 54, whose term was expiring as 53 began, so that he needed a victory; he enforced the debt laws harshly, rebuilt streets and granaries in Rome, was mocked by his colleagues as a money-grubber with no gift for war, and yet he was the most insistent advocate of one more great expedition against Parthia. Before setting out he had a lamb sacrificed at the boundary stone of the Roman city, and the entrails kept giving bad signs while the victim repeatedly broke loose and escaped; he marched anyway. The second is his eldest son Publius Crassus, then praetor and commander, who had beaten the Parthian satrap Orestes in Armenia in 54 BC and was trusted accordingly; at Carrhae he was given the Roman cavalry, pursued the Parthian archers out of formation, was enveloped, and fell together with several hundred of his riders. The third is Surena, the Parthian commander of the horse, who not only planned the feigned retreat and the encirclement on the field but afterwards, drunk on his success and regarded as a danger to the throne, was put to death by Orodes II on a charge of treason, his family going with him; the episode shows how sharp the tension between the Parthian crown and its aristocracy was. Around them stands the supporting cast: Artavasdes II of Armenia, who deliberately fed Crassus a bad road; Decimus Brutus, beaten in the north by Pacorus; and Cicero, who in De Haruspicum Responso attacked the public display of Crassus's head and called the joy with which Rome saluted a beaten general a violation of ancestral piety. Plutarch's Life of Crassus and Arrian's Epitome of Alexander are the principal later sources for the battle.
kits: 卡面科林斯青銅盔是希臘世界全覆式面甲的頂點：整片青銅一次成形，扣住頭顱後只留兩道狹窄眼孔與鼻樑，護頰與護頸一體連接，頂脊起稜，通重約一點五至二公斤，公元前七至六世紀曾大量出土於科林斯與奧林匹亞。它最大的代價正如史家所言：戴著它的人幾乎看不見，也聽不清，於是全覆面盔只配給嚴整的方陣重裝步兵，靠齊聲呼喊、旗幟與號角維持步調，人靠隊形活。公元前53年，這種面甲早已退場：羅馬軍團裝備的是前二世紀初的開面蒙特福提諾盔，只留小頂脊而無護頰，便於視野與聽覺；羅馬騎兵與高盧騎兵仍沿用希臘式帶護頰的青銅盔，可算是科林斯盔的直系後裔。安息方面，鎧甲騎披互相搭接的鐵片與皮革鱗甲，人馬俱備護具，頭戴有面罩與護頸的尖頂盔，手執長矛與新月形彎刀；弓騎用角木複合弓，每騎常備箭三十支，並攜大量備箭隨軍；前鋒更有以鐵片蒙身的駱駝隊，用來在箭雨中接近敵陣。羅馬步兵配大圓盾、短劍與標槍，軍團拋槍擲出後仍可撿回重投，輔助部隊帶克里特弓與蝎子弩等輕型投射機，另有鍋灶、帳篷與繩梯之類的營具。真正的致命處在後勤：遠征軍每人背約三十日口糧，輜重車隊沿山徑拖行，許多物資靠步兵與隨軍役畜背負，行軍縱隊被拉得極長，陣形一旦被拉開就再也合不攏。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is the summit of the full-face bronze guard in the Greek world: a single sheet of bronze formed in one piece, leaving only two narrow eye holes and a nasal when it was buckled over the head, the cheek pieces and neck guard joined in one, a ridge running over the crown, the whole thing weighing about one and a half to two kilograms, with many examples excavated at Corinth and Olympia in the seventh and sixth centuries BC. Its price was exactly what the historians note: a man wearing it could scarcely see and could scarcely hear, so the closed helm was given only to heavy infantry drawn up in rigid phalanx, whose step was kept by shouted cadence, by standards and by trumpets; the man lived by the formation. By 53 BC that closed face was long gone. Roman legionaries wore the open-faced Montefortino helm of the early second century BC, with a small knob and no cheek pieces, easy to see and hear with; the Roman and Gallic cavalry still used Greek-type bronze helms with cheek pieces, direct descendants of the Corinthian form. The Parthians, for their part, fielded cataphracts in overlapping iron scales sewn to leather, armoured men on armoured horses, wearing conical helms with face masks and neck guards, and carrying long spears and crescent blades. Their mounted archers used composite bows of horn and wood, normally carrying about thirty arrows apiece, with large quantities of reserve arrows carried on campaign. The vanguard included camel troops whose animals were sheathed in iron, so that they could close under a shower of arrows. Roman foot carried the large curved scutum, the gladius and the pilum, the javelin being recoverable and throwable again, while auxiliaries brought Cretan bows and light artillery such as the scorpio, together with the pots, tents and rope gear of a marching camp. The real fatal point, however, was logistics: each man in the expedition carried about thirty days of rations, the baggage train was dragged along mountain tracks, much of the load was carried on the backs of the foot soldiers and of the beasts of the train, and the marching column was stretched so thin that once it was pulled apart it could never be closed again.
tactics: 卡雷之戰的戰術主軸，是封閉陣形與騎兵機動之間的對比。克拉蘇放棄穿越亞美尼亞的近路，改走卡帕多細亞山道，缺水缺糧又被安息游騎連日騷擾，隊列拉長、士氣低落；安息弓騎不與羅馬正面交手，只在兩翼與後方游走射擊，輪番消耗並誘使羅馬騎兵離陣追擊。羅馬縱隊四面結成封閉方陣，中央置輜重、帳篷與非戰鬥人員，鷹旗與各軍團旗號居中，弓箭手與標槍手置於四角及突出部。追擊的羅馬騎兵被蘇雷納引開後，安息弓騎回身齊射並以兩翼包抄，將其與本陣割裂，羅馬騎兵幾乎全滅。羅馬隨即宿營於卡雷附近一片濕地沼澤，夜裡大雨，帳篷被褥濕透，輜重與牲畜陷在泥濘之中。次日拂曉，安息以鎧甲重騎與駱駝隊猛攻羅馬中軍，密集長矛與衝鋒壓垮旗線，羅馬縱隊被切成數段，步兵在無遮蔽的平原上被弓騎屠殺。普布利烏斯·克拉蘇率數百騎力圖衝出重圍而戰死；克拉蘇的坐騎被擊殺後，他在地面繼續搏鬥，最後陣亡，頭顱被帶到蘇雷納面前。整場戰役的勝負，決定在誰能看清側翼、誰能維持隊形，而不是誰的正面更硬。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of Carrhae was the contrast between a closed formation and mounted manoeuvring. Crassus gave up the short road through Armenia and took the Cappadocian mountain track instead, where water and grain were short and Parthian outriders harassed the column day after day, stretching it out and souring the men. The Parthian archers never met the Romans face to face: they worked the flanks and the rear, shooting in relays to wear the column down and to lure the Roman cavalry out of formation in pursuit. The Roman column closed into a hollow square on all four sides, with the baggage, tents and non-combatants in the middle, the eagle and the standards of the legions at the centre, and the archers and javelin men posted at the corners and on the salients. Once the pursuing Roman cavalry had been drawn off, Surena's archers turned in their horses, loosed a volley and closed with both wings, cutting the cavalry off from the main body; the Roman horse was practically annihilated. The Romans then camped in marshy ground near Carrhae, and heavy rain in the night soaked tents and bedding while the baggage and the animals sank into the mud. At dawn the Parthians struck the Roman centre with armoured horse and camel troops, and the massed lances and the charge broke the line of standards; the column was cut into sections and the foot were cut down in the open plain under the arrows. Publius Crassus tried to break out with several hundred riders and was killed; Crassus's own horse was shot down, he kept fighting on his feet, and was finally killed, his head carried to Surena. What decided the battle was not which front was harder, but who could see his flanks and who could hold a formation together.
data: 可查的數字集中在兵員與日期上。克拉蘇的羅馬軍包括七個軍團，步兵約兩萬至兩萬二千人，羅馬騎兵約三千人，另有高盧、色雷斯、日耳曼雇傭騎兵約三千人，輕裝步兵與射手另計。普林尼《自然史》記安息方面的馬匹總數以十萬計，其中弓騎約一萬，另有數千名全身披甲的鎧甲騎，鎧甲駱駝騎士約一千；這個數字應視為戰報式的誇大，能真正投入戰鬥的騎兵遠少於此。普林尼另記安息弓騎每人常備箭三十支，並攜大量備箭，箭幕是消滅羅馬步兵的主要手段。戰役日期一般定在公元前53年5月9日（普林尼），另有學者主張4月之說。羅馬方面的損失近乎全軍覆沒：七個軍團被衝散，步兵絕大多數陣亡或被俘，被俘者約一萬人淪為奴隸或被押往安息本土，騎兵損失從三百至數千不等，安息方面的損失史料幾乎不載。這是共和國時期單次會戰中最慘重的編制損失之一，與坎尼會戰相比亦不遜色。安息騎兵自卡雷向西追擊羅馬殘兵數日，並以游騎切斷退往敘利亞的通道。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around numbers of men and the date. Crassus's Roman army comprised seven legions, about twenty to twenty-two thousand foot, about three thousand Roman cavalry, and about three thousand mercenary horse from Gauls, Thracians and Germans, with light infantry and skirmishers counted apart. Pliny the Elder, in the Natural History, gives the total of horses on the Parthian side as one hundred thousand, of which about ten thousand were mounted archers, with several thousand fully armoured cataphracts and about one thousand armoured camel riders; that figure should be read as a boast put into battle-report form, since the horse actually brought into action were far fewer. Pliny also records that each Parthian archer normally carried about thirty arrows, with large stocks of reserve arrows carried on campaign, and it was this curtain of arrows that did most of the killing among the Roman foot. The battle is generally dated to 9 May 53 BC on Pliny's authority, though some scholars argue for April. The Roman losses were very nearly a total annihilation: the seven legions were broken up, the great majority of the foot were killed or captured, about ten thousand prisoners were enslaved or marched off into Parthian territory, and the cavalry losses ran from three hundred to several thousand; the Parthian losses are scarcely recorded at all. This was among the gravest losses of a single engagement in the Republic's history, comparable with Cannae. The Parthian horse pursued the Roman remnants westwards for several days and used outriders to cut the road back to Syria.
cause: 打起這場戰爭有四層原因。最上層是羅馬的東進政策：龐培於前66至前63年遠征安息，把安息逼回幼發拉底斯東岸，卻未能消滅其騎兵主力；前三頭同盟把東方戰區留給克拉蘇，克拉蘇在前55年當選執政官時提出的政見就是再組大軍東征，以重整亞細亞戰功為號召。第二層是政治算計：克拉蘇任期將滿，同盟中龐培、凱撒各有戰區，他需要一場速勝來鞏固自己的地位；元老院則希望用一場邊疆勝利壓住他日益膨脹的財勢與私人武力。第三層是安息方面的時機：奧羅德斯二世正把美索不達米亞的附庸城邑收回，羅馬內戰自前54年凱撒在阿萊西亞得手後逐漸成形，安息判斷西邊不會有援軍。第四層是羅馬自己的失誤：克拉蘇輕敵，拒絕聽取有經驗者的勸告；亞美尼亞王阿爾塔瓦斯得二世有意把他引上缺水缺糧的山道；行軍數月之後他已無法在有利時機作戰，宿營濕地、備糧不繼，於是安息弓騎不需要贏，只需要拖。
causeEn: Four layers of cause lie behind this war. At the top is Roman eastern policy: Pompey's campaign against Parthia in 66 to 63 BC had pushed Parthia back to the eastern bank of the Euphrates without destroying its mounted core, and the First Triumvirate left the eastern theatre to Crassus, whose programme on being elected consul in 55 BC was precisely to raise another great army and march east, to renew the credit of Asia. The second layer is political arithmetic: Crassus's term was ending, Pompey and Caesar each had their own theatre, and he needed a quick victory to shore up his own standing, while the senate hoped a frontier triumph would rein in his swelling wealth and private military power. The third layer is the Parthian moment: Orodes II was tightening his grip on the client cities of Mesopotamia, and as the Roman civil war took shape after Caesar's success at Alesia in 54 BC, Parthia judged that no relief would come from the west. The fourth layer is Rome's own mistakes. Crassus underestimated his enemy and refused to listen to those with experience; Artavasdes II of Armenia deliberately steered him onto a track short of water and grain; and after months on the march he could no longer choose the moment and ground for a battle, camping in marsh and running short of provisions, so that the Parthian archers never needed to win, only to drag.
impact: 卡雷的後果，遠遠超過一場會戰的分量。羅馬失去了東方的野戰主力：從公元前53年到公元114年圖拉真攻入美索不達米亞、拿下巴比倫與塞琉古亞之前，兩河流域實質上歸安息控制，羅馬在東方只剩一個收縮的敘利亞前線。克拉蘇本人生死帶著三重餘震：其一，前三頭同盟實際解體，凱撒與龐培的對立成為共和國晚期的主軸，前52年龐培全勝、前49年內戰爆發，克拉蘇的失敗成了凱撒獨大的轉折點；其二，克拉蘇的頭顱被送回羅馬並公開展示，引來西塞罗在《占卜者的答覆》中的譴責，認為祖國為敗將歡呼有違古老的虔敬之義，這場辯論牽動當時的宗教觀與共和道德；其三，蘇雷納在得勝後因居功自大而被奧羅德斯二世誅殺，說明安息內部王權與貴族勢力的衝突同樣激烈，而安息在公元前53年登上戰爭高峰後便無力再西進，羅馬的機會由此而來。此役也讓羅馬記住了對安息必須用守禦而非進攻的教訓，直到前20年屋大維才以外交手段取回克拉蘇失落於安息的軍旗。
impactEn: The consequences of Carrhae weighed far more than the fate of one battle. Rome lost her field army in the east: from 53 BC until Trajan entered Mesopotamia in AD 114 and took Babylon and Seleucia, the two river lands were effectively Parthian, and Rome's eastern front shrank to a defensive line in Syria. Crassus's own death carried three aftershocks. First, the First Triumvirate dissolved in substance and the opposition of Caesar and Pompey became the main axis of the late Republic, with Pompey's complete victory in 52 BC and the outbreak of civil war in 49 BC: Crassus's defeat was the turning point that left Caesar supreme. Second, Crassus's head was carried back to Rome and put on public display, and Cicero attacked the act in De Haruspicum Responso, arguing that a city which rejoiced over a beaten general had violated the ancient piety of its ancestors; the argument stirred the religious climate and the republican morality of the moment. Third, Surena, drunk on his victory and seen as a threat, was put to death by Orodes II, which showed that the tension between crown and nobility inside Parthia was just as fierce, and that Parthia, after reaching the high point of its war in 53 BC, had no strength left to advance westward; Rome's opening came from there. The campaign also taught Rome that Parthia had to be met with defence rather than with invasion, and only in 20 BC did Octavian recover by diplomacy the military standards Crassus had lost to Parthia.
result: 公元前53年5月9日，蘇雷納率安息騎兵在美索不達米亞平原上打垮羅馬遠征軍。經過是這樣的：克拉蘇與其子普布利烏斯相繼陣亡，七個軍團的方陣被衝破，約一萬名羅馬兵被俘，餘部或死於箭雨或淪為奴隸，輜重與野戰器材盡為安息所得，羅馬在東方的野戰力量一時盡空。克拉蘇本人的結局最為人記得：他在最後時刻拒絕逃走，坐騎被殺後在地面力戰而死，普魯塔克卻以膽怯者的死譏之；蘇雷納收到他的頭顱時為之落淚，隨後將它送交奧羅德斯二世。戰後安息並未乘勢深入敘利亞，反而在北方由帕科魯斯於阿拉克斯河再勝一仗，把前線推至亞美尼亞；羅馬直到前51年卡西烏斯在敘利亞再度受挫，才真正意識到東方的分量。此役沒有分出勝負之外的第二層意義：它是羅馬共和國一次徹底的失敗，也是一場讓安息自以為天下再無對手的勝利。
resultEn: On 9 May 53 BC Surena's Parthian horse broke Crassus's expeditionary army on the plain of Mesopotamia. The course of it was this: Crassus and his son Publius were killed in turn, the square of seven legions was shattered, about ten thousand Romans were taken prisoner, the rest died under the arrows or were enslaved, the baggage and the field equipment fell to the Parthians, and the Roman field force in the east was momentarily annihilated. Crassus's own end is the part best remembered: he refused to run at the last moment, his horse was killed under him and he fought on his feet until he fell, and Plutarch jeered at it as the death of a coward. Surena wept when Crassus's head was brought to him and then sent it on to Orodes II. After the victory Parthia did not press on into Syria; in the north, by contrast, Pacorus won another battle at the Araxes and pushed the frontier back towards Armenia, and Rome did not grasp the weight of the east until Cassius was beaten again in Syria in 51 BC. The battle carries no second meaning beyond its result: it was a total defeat for the Roman Republic and a victory that left Parthia convinced it had no rival left in the world.
